name: Ro07-3953
summary: Ro07-3953 (Diflunordazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative which is the 2',6'-difluoro derivative of nordazepam. It was invented in the 1970s but was never marketed, however it has recently appeared on the market as a designer drug, first reported in Sweden in December 2024.

uses.text: It was invented in the 1970s but was never marketed, however it has recently appeared on the market as a designer drug, first reported in Sweden in December 2024.

pharmacology.en: Like other benzodiazepines, it is thought to boost the effect of GABA, the brain's main calming signal, at GABA-A receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他苯二氮平類藥物一樣，它被認為會在GABA-A受體上增強GABA的作用，GABA是大腦主要的抑制訊號。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他苯二氮平类药物一样，它被认为会在GABA-A受体上增强GABA的作用，GABA是大脑主要的抑制信号。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory gaps, and in overdose breathing can slow dangerously. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly can bring on seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的苯二氮平類藥物會造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶空白，過量時呼吸可能危險地變慢。規律使用會造成依賴，突然停用可能引發癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的苯二氮平类药物会造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆空白，过量时呼吸可能危险地变慢。规律使用会造成依赖，突然停用可能引发癫痫发作。

fact.en: The Ro in its code name shows it came from the Swiss drug company Hoffmann-La Roche, the maker of Valium, which explored many benzodiazepines in the 1960s and 1970s.
fact.zh: 它代號中的Ro代表它出自瑞士藥廠羅氏（Hoffmann-La Roche），也就是煩寧（Valium）的製造商，該公司在1960與1970年代研究過大量苯二氮平類化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它代号中的Ro代表它出自瑞士药厂罗氏（Hoffmann-La Roche），也就是烦宁（Valium）的制造商，该公司在1960与1970年代研究过大量苯二氮平类化合物。
